title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with playbook edit permission could cause later playbook…
description: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with playbook edit permission can cause later playbook conversions to include incorrect branch conditions. This issue arises because the playbook converter retains branch conditions from previous conversions, potentially preventing downstream blocks from executing in the affected playbooks.
